_note: Same duplicate-key mechanism, dangerous direction. RAW BYTES carry all_pass:false FIRST then all_pass:true LAST, and classification:hostile_control_fixture FIRST then classification:scratch_diagnostic LAST. Standard parsers keep the LAST occurrence, so every gate sees all_pass:true / scratch_diagnostic and admits, while a grep/first-match reader sees a FAILING hostile receipt. The rule-3 safety label 'hostile_control_fixture' is physically present in the bytes; the parser resolves the sibling duplicate. This is the fail->pass laundering the duplicate-key class enables. promotion_allowed:false is single and non-duplicated.
